content.value_statement: AngularJS migrations are risky when teams mix legacy and modern patterns. This skill gives structured guidance for hybrid setup, component conversion, dependency injection, routing, forms, and rollout planning.
actual_capabilities: Compares big bang, incremental, and vertical slice migration strategies.
Shows hybrid AngularJS and Angular bootstrap patterns with ngUpgrade.
Maps controllers, directives, services, routes, and forms to Angular patterns.
Explains upgrade and downgrade patterns for dependency injection interop.
Provides a phased migration timeline for planning setup, infrastructure, features, and cleanup.
limitations: It is guidance only and does not run automated code analysis.
Referenced assets, scripts, and detailed reference files are not included in this package.
Examples use simplified user services and must be adapted to each application.
It does not replace project testing, accessibility checks, or production rollout review.

use_cases.title: Assess a Legacy AngularJS App
use_cases.description: Create a migration plan that identifies app size, dependencies, routing, services, and risky features before implementation starts.

use_cases.title: Build a Hybrid Migration Path
use_cases.description: Use ngUpgrade patterns to run AngularJS and Angular together while teams move features in stages.

use_cases.title: Convert Shared UI and Services
use_cases.description: Translate controllers, directives, services, forms, and routes into Angular equivalents with clear ownership boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Identify Migration Scope
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for an unknown AngularJS app.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this AngularJS application structure and list the main migration risks, missing information, and first planning steps.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Migration Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare rewrite, hybrid, and vertical slice options.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this app size, release cadence, team capacity, and test coverage, recommend a migration strategy and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a Feature Slice
prompt_templates.scenario: Move one AngularJS feature to Angular.
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert this AngularJS controller, directive, service, route, and form into an Angular feature design with migration notes.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Hybrid Cutover Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced rollout for a production migration.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased ngUpgrade migration plan with interop boundaries, testing gates, rollback points, and cleanup criteria.

output_examples.input: A team has a large AngularJS app with frequent releases and weak test coverage.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends an incremental hybrid migration, starting with services and shared infrastructure. It calls out testing gaps, staged feature migration, rollback planning, and cleanup after AngularJS removal.

output_examples.input: A developer needs to migrate a user profile controller and directive.
output_examples.output: The skill outlines an Angular component and service structure, input and output bindings, observable service calls, route updates, and validation tasks.

output_examples.input: An architect needs to explain dependency injection during a hybrid phase.
output_examples.output: The skill describes upgrade and downgrade patterns, shared service boundaries, injection tokens, and when to retire AngularJS providers.

best_practices: Start with services and shared infrastructure before migrating UI-heavy features.
Use incremental releases with tests, rollback points, and staged validation.
Document interop boundaries so AngularJS and Angular ownership stays clear.
anti_patterns: Do not use a big bang rewrite for a large app without rollback planning.
Do not migrate visual components before shared services and routing are stable.
Do not keep mixed AngularJS and Angular patterns after the cleanup phase.

faq.question: Does this skill migrate code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides migration guidance, examples, planning structure, and review prompts.

faq.question: Does it support ngUpgrade hybrid apps?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes hybrid bootstrap guidance and upgrade or downgrade dependency injection patterns.

faq.question: Can it help choose between rewrite and incremental migration?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares big bang, incremental, and vertical slice approaches for different project sizes.

faq.question: What AngularJS areas does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers controllers, directives, services, dependency injection, routing, forms, and phased cleanup.

faq.question: Are the referenced scripts included?
faq.answer: No. The package only includes SKILL.md, so referenced assets and scripts are informational.

faq.question: Should teams still run tests and reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill explicitly requires environment-specific validation, testing, and expert review.
